def main():
    n = 2

    names = ["Eric", "Arnold"]
    drinks = ["water", "tea"]
    occupations = ["engineer", "doctor"]

    name = [Int(f"name_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    drink = [Int(f"drink_{i}") for i in range(n)]
    occupation = [Int(f"occupation_{i}") for i in range(n)]

    solver = Solver()

    for i in range(n):
        solver.add(Or(*[name[i] == j for j in range(len(names))]))
        solver.add(Or(*[drink[i] == j for j in range(len(drinks))]))
        solver.add(Or(*[occupation[i] == j for j in range(len(occupations))]))

    solver.add(Distinct(*name))
    solver.add(Distinct(*drink))
    solver.add(Distinct(*occupation))

    ERIC = 0
    DOCTOR = 1
    WATER = 0

    # Clue 1: Eric is the doctor.
    for i in range(n):
        solver.add((name[i] == ERIC) == (occupation[i] == DOCTOR))

    # Clue 2: The water drinker is directly left of the doctor.
    solver.add(Or(*[
        And(drink[i] == WATER, occupation[i + 1] == DOCTOR)
        for i in range(n - 1)
    ]))

    if solver.check() != sat:
        return

    model = solver.model()

    for i in range(n):
        name_val = model.eval(name[i]).as_long()
        drink_val = model.eval(drink[i]).as_long()
        occupation_val = model.eval(occupation[i]).as_long()

        print(

            f"{names[name_val]}, "
            f"{drinks[drink_val]}, "
            f"{occupations[occupation_val]}"
        )
